rawFindings.title: Redirect body uses status code instead of target URL for two-argument redirects
rawFindings.explanation: In the `res.redirect(status, url)` overload, the `url` parameter is the numeric status code and the actual redirect target is stored in `address`. Using `url` here makes the generated response body point to the status code rather than the Location value.
rawFindings.suggestion: Build redirect bodies from `address` after `this.location(address)` (and use `address` in the HTML branch as well).
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: For `res.redirect(301, 'http://google.com')` with `Accept: text/plain`, the response has `Location: http://google.com` but body `Moved Permanently. Redirecting to 301` instead of `Moved Permanently. Redirecting to http://google.com`.
